scores.description: The score of each question by question id, as decimal text.

published_by.description: Who published the grade; `null` for a grade the system published.

score.description: A decimal number as text; `null` when only feedback was published.

PluginAssignment.description: An assignment as a student can see it: open, with its published title.

fields.description:
The fields of a `form` (`id`, `type`, `label`, `help`, `required`, `options`, `rules`); absent
for the other types.

updated_at.description: When the assignment, its title or its settings last changed.

items.description: Those of the ids who are in a course the plugin reaches. The others are left out.

PluginFormAnswers.description: The values a student gave in a `form`, by field id.

PluginQuiz.description:
The questions of a quiz as a student sees them: no `correct`, `answer`, `tolerance`,
`accepted`, `explanation`, `partial_credit` or `grading_notes`.

PluginReport.description: A report of one plugin on a submitted attempt, an assignment or a course, for the staff who may see it.

key.description: The name the plugin gave this report: it keeps one report per key on a subject.

plugin_id.description: The id the plugin gave in its manifest.

PluginSettings.description:
The settings of a plugin as an administrator configured them, with the defaults of its manifest
where nothing was set. A setting with neither is not in `values`.

values.description:
Setting key to value: a string, a number, a boolean or a list. Secrets are in clear: the
plugin is who they were entered for.

PluginSubmission.description:
A submitted attempt as a plugin with `submissions:read` sees it: which work, whose, and what it
says. No draft, no score and no grade.

content.description:
A block document for a `text` assignment, `{"answers": {...}}` for a quiz or a form,
`{"files": [...], "comment"?}` for a file.

id.description: The id the `submission.submitted` event carries as `submission_id`.

PutReportRequest.description:
What a plugin says about a submitted attempt, an assignment or a course. It replaces the plugin's
earlier report on the subject under the same key.

data.description: What a program may want: a JSON object of at most 16 KiB.

summary.description: One line for people to read, 1 to 500 characters.

get.summary:
The published assignments that were deleted, by the time they went (ADR-0081). The scope
`assignments:read`. A draft that was deleted was never shown and is not here; an assignment that
merely stops being visible to students is not a deletion either (it stops being listed, and its
id is `404`). Only an
assignment without submitted work or grades can be deleted. Kept `plugins.tombstone_days` days.
